introduction.text: Cal Hacks 13.0 是三天的线下黑客松，参与者协作开发创新技术作品，并参加工作坊和分享。场地为旧金山 Palace of Fine Arts；项目构思可提前进行，但实现必须在活动期间完成。主站与 Devpost 对参赛资格和组队人数的规定存在差异，需结合官方规则核对。

citations.excerpt: Cal Hacks is a 3-day hackathon, where hackers creatively collaborate on innovative technology for a chance to win prizes including cash, and attend workshops and panels to learn more about emerging tech!

The Palace of Fine Arts
3601 Lyon St, San Francisco, CA 94123
You cannot work on a project you started before the hackathon. Ideation before the hackathon is allowed, but all implementation must occur during the hackathon.
We will be launching a whole month of tech talks, workshops, and hack nights leading up to Cal Hacks 13.0! Stay tuned for more information!

How many people can be on a single team?
Up to 4 people can be part of a single team.
+
−
What qualifies as a beginner team?
Every team member must be a first-time hacker. Note that attending a prior hackathon and not submitting a project or demoing still counts as having prior experience. We will be verifying with outside sources upon choosing winners.
+
−
Do I have to have a team to participate?
Not at all! You can come with a team or solo. Whatever works for you!
Team required: 2 to 4 members
Cal Hacks is open to undergraduate and graduate students as well as new grads of under 1 year from all colleges and universities. Those who graduated prior to Fall 2025 will not qualify.

Ages 18+ only
College students only
